stories.title: Lotofácil 3789: ganhador único leva prêmio principal; aposta foi feita em São Paulo

en.title: Lotofácil 3789: single winner takes main prize; bet placed in São Paulo
en.summary: A single winner claimed the main prize in the Lotofácil 3789 lottery draw, with the winning bet purchased in São Paulo.

stories.title: Executivos de bets vão da perplexidade à revolta após MP que as coloca na ilegalidade

en.title: Betting executives go from bewilderment to outrage after provisional measure placing them in illegality
en.summary: Brazilian betting company executives reacted with anger to a provisional measure signed by President Lula declaring their operations illegal, despite the government having sold 85 five-year licenses for 30 million reais each over the past two years.

stories.title: Como a cultura dos orangotangos é transmitida aos seus filhotes

en.title: How orangutan culture is transmitted to their offspring
en.summary: Orangutan offspring learn cultural behaviors from their parents through observation and curiosity, similar to how young primates of other species acquire knowledge about their environment.

stories.title: Campo Grande tem vacinação gratuita contra a raiva para cães e gatos neste fim de semana

en.title: Campo Grande offers free rabies vaccination for dogs and cats this weekend
en.summary: The municipal health authority in Campo Grande is providing free rabies vaccinations for dogs and cats on Saturday and Sunday at fixed locations and through house-to-house visits in certain neighborhoods.

stories.title: 'Não esboçava sentimentos', diz delegada sobre homem preso por envolvimento na morte da irmã em RO

en.title: 'Showed no emotion', says police delegate about man arrested for involvement in sister's death in RO
en.summary: A 24-year-old man was arrested on Thursday in Rondônia on suspicion of participating in his sister's death. Police identified suspicious behavior including emotional detachment and haste to bury the victim as key factors in the investigation.

stories.title: CFMoto terá três novos quadriciclos no Brasil em 2027; veja quais são

en.title: CFMoto will have three new ATVs in Brazil in 2027; see which ones
en.summary: CFMoto plans to introduce three new all-terrain vehicle models to the Brazilian market by 2027.

stories.title: Deputado estadual Amilton Filho morre em acidente na BR-050

en.title: State Deputy Amilton Filho dies in accident on BR-050
en.summary: State Deputy Amilton Filho died in a traffic collision on a federal highway near Cristalina, Goiás early Saturday morning while returning from a campaign event. Two other passengers in the vehicle survived the crash.

stories.title: Polícia não descarta hipótese de que casal suspeito de matar americano no Paraná deixou o Brasil

en.title: Police do not rule out hypothesis that couple suspected of killing American in Paraná left Brazil
en.summary: Two suspects in the death of a 46-year-old American in Paraná may have fled Brazil, according to police investigation. The victims was found bound with adhesive tape in Maringá.

stories.title: Você sabe tudo sobre a história de Nossa Senhora Aparecida? Faça o quiz e veja!

en.title: Do you know everything about the history of Our Lady of Aparecida? Take the quiz and see!
en.summary: G1 has created a quiz to test knowledge about Our Lady of Aparecida ahead of the October 12 celebration, which is expected to draw thousands of pilgrims to the National Sanctuary.

stories.title: Polícia busca suspeitos de matar americano desenvolvedor de jogos no Paraná

en.title: Police search for suspects in death of American game developer in Paraná
en.summary: Police in Maringá are seeking a 20-year-old man and 18-year-old woman suspected of robbery resulting in death of American game developer Tamir Nadav, 46, known for creating Minecraft and Batman games.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro vê estrago com notícia falsa sobre Nossa Senhora e tenta conter danos

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign sees damage from false news about Nossa Senhora and attempts to contain it
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign moved to counter misinformation circulating on social media falsely claiming he intended to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patron saint.

stories.title: Deputado Amilton Filho morre em acidente na BR-050, em Cristalina (GO)

en.title: State Deputy Amilton Filho dies in accident on BR-050 in Cristalina (GO)
en.summary: State deputy Amilton Filho of the MDB party died early Saturday morning in a car accident on BR-050 highway in the Cristalina region of Goiás.

stories.title: EUA e China concordam com alívio tarifário para US$ 30 bilhões em produtos não sensíveis de cada lado

en.title: USA and China agree on tariff relief for $30 billion in non-sensitive products on each side
en.summary: The United States and China agreed to recommendations for more favorable tariff treatment covering $30 billion in non-sensitive products traded in both directions, according to the White House following a summit between the two presidents.

stories.title: STF condena Eduardo Bolsonaro a 1 ano de prisão por difamação contra Tabata

en.title: Supreme Court condemns Eduardo Bolsonaro to 1 year in prison for defamation against Tabata
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court convicted former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro of defamation against deputy Tabata Amaral and ordered him to serve one year in prison plus pay a fine exceeding 80,000 reais. The conviction relates to a 2021 social media post where Bolsonaro criticized Amaral's proposal to distribute feminine hygiene products.

stories.title: Federação União Brasil/PP tende a crescer na Câmara e PL a cair, segundo DIAP

en.title: União Brasil/PP federation tends to grow in Chamber and PL to decline, according to DIAP
en.summary: Initial projections suggest minor shifts in Chamber of Deputies party blocs, with the União Brasil and PP federation likely to become the largest bloc. The analysis comes from the Parliamentary Advisory Department's assessment ahead of upcoming elections.

stories.title: O evento empresarial que se transformou em ato de campanha

en.title: The business event that transformed into a campaign rally
en.summary: An event announced as a business gathering featuring President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in São Paulo became a campaign act defending institutional democracy amid a political crisis. The event echoed democratic defense themes from the 2022 election dispute.

stories.title: Jantar de Lula com empresários lota em São Paulo, e MP das bets repercute bem entre presentes

en.title: Lula's dinner with businesspeople fills venue in São Paulo, and betting MP receives positive reception among attendees
en.summary: President Lula held a dinner with prominent executives and bankers in São Paulo on Friday that drew a large and influential crowd. The event was well-received by business leaders attending, and discussions included a measure on betting regulations.
